title: Roasted Lamb with Asian Glaze
description: A Chinese-inspired roasted lamb dish with a sweet and savory glaze, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Season the lamb leg with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Rub the glaze all over the lamb leg, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb leg until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
